# Unit Economics Worksheet (Back-of-the-Envelope)

## Inputs (Use Ranges if Unknown)
### Revenue
- Price (per month / per seat / per transaction):
- Average revenue per customer (ARPA):
- Average contract length (months) or churn rate (%/month):

### Costs (Variable)
- Cost of goods sold (COGS) per customer (hosting, support, payment fees, fulfillment):
- Support hours per customer per month:
- Third-party costs per customer:

### Acquisition
- CAC (blended) per customer:
- Sales cycle length (if B2B):

## Calculations
- Gross margin $ = ARPA − COGS
- Gross margin % = (ARPA − COGS) / ARPA
- Payback months = CAC / gross margin $

If using churn:
- Simple LTV (gross margin basis) ≈ gross margin $ / churn_rate_per_month

Sanity checks:
- LTV:CAC should be comfortably > 1 for viability (target varies by business model).
- Payback months should match cash constraints.

## Notes
- Biggest uncertainty:
- Sensitivity: which input changes the outcome most?
- What evidence do you need next to narrow the range?
